role: Minister-Delegate for Francophonie, International Partnerships and French Nationals Abroad
description: Minister-Delegate to the Minister for Europe and Foreign Affairs, in charge of Francophonie, international partnerships and French nationals abroad. Appointed October 2025 and retained in the 26 February 2026 reshuffle.

role: Member of the National Assembly, 2nd constituency for French residents abroad
description: Deputy for the 2nd constituency for French residents abroad (Latin America and the Caribbean) following the 2024 legislative election; vice-president of the Committee on Foreign Affairs. Mandate ended on appointment to government.

role: Member of the National Assembly, 2nd constituency for French residents abroad
description: Returned to the National Assembly after the Constitutional Council annulled the 2022 result and ordered a re-run, which she won in 2023. Member, later vice-president, of the Committee on Foreign Affairs.

role: Member of the National Assembly, 2nd constituency for French residents abroad
description: First elected in the June 2022 legislative election; mandate ended in January 2023 after the Constitutional Council annulled the result over a technical failure in internet voting.

role: Member of the supervisory board / board of directors
description: Member of the board of the French Development Agency (declared periods 09/2022–06/2024 and 10/2024–10/2025), unremunerated.

role: Member of the board of directors
description: Member of the board of Business France, unremunerated.

role: Councillor of French Nationals Abroad (Conseillère des Français de l'étranger)
description: Elected councillor representing French nationals abroad prior to entering the National Assembly.

role: Referent for Latin America (Référente Amérique latine)
description: Party referent for Latin America, unremunerated.
